# Archived upstream workflows

These workflow definitions are kept for reference, outside `.github/workflows` so GitHub Actions does not run them. They are not maintained as runnable workflows in this fork. Some rely on Microsoft runners, services, credentials, or rules; companion files remain in their original locations.

When syncing from upstream, review `.github/workflows` before merging. An upstream sync can add workflows or restore archived ones. Keep `fork-ci.yml` as the only active workflow unless any additions have been reviewed for this fork.
